senses.gloss: f. (= שְׁרָרִי׳; שְׁרַר; cmp. כָּשׁוֹרָא) [binder,] joist, beam, post.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 19:8">Targ. O. Gen. XIX, 8</cite> ed. <he>שָׁרוּתִי</he> Berl. (ed. Vien. <cite ref="U01937"><he>שֵׁרוּ׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 6:2">Targ. II Kings VI, 2</cite> <he>שדי</he> ed. Lag. (corr. acc.; ed. <cite ref="K01300"><he>כשורא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 6:5">Ib. 5</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 89:8">Gen. R. s. 89</cite> <he>חמית בחלמי ש׳ דביתי וכ׳</he> I saw in my dream the main beam of my house broken; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>הדא אתתא</he>).

<cite ref="Eruvin 102a:11">Erub. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>ההיא ש׳ דהוה בי וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="E00174"><he>ההוא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) a beam lying on the ground of R. P. which required ten persons to lift it, and they put it before the door (as a bar). Y. ib. I, 19ᵃ bot. <he>חמא … שָׁרִיתֵיה כריחא</he> (not <he>בריחיא</he>) he saw an entrance (v. <cite ref="M00078"><he>מָבוֹי</he></cite>) the beam over which was rotten.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:22">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="R00480"><he>צְלַב</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115:12">Yalk. ib. 115</cite> <cite ref="U02050"><he>שרתא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="U01978"><he>שַׁרְיָיתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01991"><he>שַׁרְיָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01939"><he>שַׁרְוָו׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01975"><he>שַׁרְיָין</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01979"><he>שַׁרְיָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 6:9">Ib. 9</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="U02014"><he>שִׁרְיָ׳</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 35:20">Targ. Y. Num. XXXV, 20</cite> <he>שַׁרְיַית</he> Kimḥi (ed. Vien. <cite ref="U01940"><he>שַׁרְוָותָה</he></cite>).—Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ bot. <he>מי … תרתין שרין עבר וכ׳</he> (not <he>ועכד</he>) when both went out carrying two beams (on which to be hanged), R. A. passed &c.
